historical_context.headline: A mail-in trade from Pokémon’s first era
historical_context.summary: This Charizard was offered through Japan’s 1998 Trade Please campaign. Collectors mailed the campaign flyer, any two Pokémon cards, and a return envelope to Media Factory; choosing Course A returned this unnumbered Charizard with the Trade Please! promotional card.
historical_context.later_history: Reference histories also record this Charizard print in the later Pokémon Song Best Collection release. A loose card does not by itself establish which distribution it came from.

effects.text: 手からクロバットに草、火、またはサイキックの基本エネルギーカードを取り付けると、クロバットのタイプ（色）はターンの終わりまでそのタイプのエネルギーと同じになります。

effects.label: 毒の炎
effects.text: 20 · コインをひっくり返します。頭の場合、防御するポケモンは燃やされ、毒されます。

effects.label: 四角い攻撃
effects.text: 4コインをひっくり返します。この攻撃は、ヘッド数の20倍のダメージを与えます。

cards.attack: 共感的な癒し · マインドベンド

effects.label: クリスタルタイプ
effects.text: 手からセレビに草、水、またはサイキックの基本エネルギーカードを取り付けると、セレビのタイプ（色）はターンの終わりまでそのタイプのエネルギーと同じになります。

effects.label: 共感的な癒し
effects.text: セレビと、セレビと同じタイプ（色）の各ポケモンから2つのダメージカウンターを削除します。

effects.label: マインドベンド
effects.text: 20 · コインをひっくり返します。頭の場合、防御ポケモンは混乱しています。

scope_note: Japanese vintage and English Wizards-era Pokémon printings through the May 2003 boundary. Catalogue artwork is a reference—not seller evidence, image-rights approval, authentication, condition, or proof of a physical card.

relationship_policy.same_card_localized_printing: A source explicitly places the localized printings in the same card lineage.
relationship_policy.same_artwork_reprint: A source explicitly identifies the same illustration/card reprint.
relationship_policy.related_character_only: The cards depict the same character but are not asserted to be the same card.
relationship_policy.prohibited_shortcut: Name-only, Pokédex-number-only, or set-proximity matches may not be promoted to same-card relationships.

history_policy.confidence: Attributed history is catalogue context supported by named references. It is not direct evidence about a seller’s physical copy.

research_policy.coverage: Every card inherits source-linked release context and keeps card-specific facts separate.
research_policy.card_specific_claims: Artist, number, language, species, rules, and variant fields come from the individual catalogue row when recorded.
research_policy.release_claims: Release history is shared context. It does not prove how a loose seller copy was acquired.
research_policy.unknowns: Missing artist or release details remain visibly not recorded; they are never inferred from another printing.
